Class LowerPile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.LowerPile
public class LowerPile extends Object
Represents the lower row of cards on the game board. Manages the storage and lifecycle of tribe cards and building cards that have shifted down from the upper row, as well as the resolution of events.

    • resolveLowerRowEvents

      public void resolveLowerRowEvents(ArrayList<Player> players)
      Resolves all event cards currently present in the lower row's tribe cards.

      Events are split into two groups and resolved in the following order:

      1. All regular EventCards that are not SustenanceEventCards, sorted by their Era from oldest to newest.
      2. All SustenanceEventCards, likewise sorted by Era from oldest to newest.
      Every regular event is therefore resolved before any sustenance event, regardless of Era.
      Parameters:
      players - The list of players affected by the events.
